states.name: Initial Scene

states.name: Artifacts Placed

states.name: Spotlights Activated

states.name: Colors Assigned
states.description: Each spotlight has been assigned a unique color via color picker inputs

states.name: Intensity Adjusted

states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.allArtifactsPlaced === true && window.__3D_STATE__.spotlightsActiveCount === 3 && window.__3D_STATE__.uniqueSpotlightColors === 3 && window.__3D_STATE__.lanternSpotlightIntensity >= 0.5 && window.__3D_STATE__.chessSpotlightIntensity >= 0.5 && window.__3D_STATE__.cameraSpotlightIntensity >= 0.5 && window.__3D_STATE__.exhibitComplete === false

states.name: Exhibit Complete
states.description: All artifacts placed, all spotlights configured with unique colors and proper intensities

states.name: Stability Verified
states.description: Exhibit remains stable and properly configured for extended duration

action.code: const lantern = window.scene.getObjectByName('lantern'); const chess = window.scene.getObjectByName('chess'); const camera = window.scene.getObjectByName('camera'); const leftPedestal = new THREE.Vector3(-3, 0.5, 0); const centerPedestal = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.5, 0); const rightPedestal = new THREE.Vector3(3, 0.5, 0); if(lantern) lantern.position.copy(leftPedestal); if(chess) chess.position.copy(centerPedestal); if(camera) camera.position.copy(rightPedestal);

postconditions: Lantern model is positioned within 0.5 units of left pedestal center
Chess set model is positioned within 0.5 units of center pedestal center
Antique camera model is positioned within 0.5 units of right pedestal center

action.code: const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button'); buttons.forEach((btn, i) => { if(btn.textContent.includes('Spotlight') || btn.textContent.includes('Light')) btn.click(); });

postconditions: All three spotlights are activated and visible in the scene

action.code: const colorPickers = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="color"]'); if(colorPickers[0]) colorPickers[0].value = '#ff0000'; if(colorPickers[1]) colorPickers[1].value = '#00ff00'; if(colorPickers[2]) colorPickers[2].value = '#0000ff'; colorPickers.forEach(cp => cp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})));

postconditions: Each spotlight has a unique color assigned
No two spotlights share the same color value

action.code: const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); if(sliders[0]) { sliders[0].value = '2.0'; sliders[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } if(sliders[1]) { sliders[1].value = '2.5'; sliders[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } if(sliders[2]) { sliders[2].value = '1.8'; sliders[2].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: All spotlight intensities are set within valid range (0.5-3.0)
Each spotlight has a distinct intensity value

action.code: const lantern = window.scene.getObjectByName('lantern'); if(lantern) lantern.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4;

postconditions: Exhibit is fully configured with all artifacts placed and lit
Exhibit complete flag is set to true
All state values remain valid and unchanged
No errors or degradation in scene rendering
